name: tilttek/rating
description: Per-game ratings of players from their results: Elo with a decreasing K, OpenSkill with Plackett-Luce or Thurstone-Mosteller and a conservative ranking, duels, games of several players and teams, draws, an unrated friendly mode, ratings private by default, a replay that gives the same values, and the events of a celebration.

suggest.tilttek/play-log: To replay the ratings of a game from its log of plays, through a source of results
